topic: Choosing kids' frames: flexible, right size, sturdy (FOE)

youtube.title: Kids break glasses a lot! Choose frames like this 👦👓 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Kids drop, bend and sit on their glasses. Here's how to pick frames that survive.
குழந்தைகளுக்குச் சரியான ஃப்ரேம் எப்படித் தேர்வு செய்வது?

• DO pick flexible frames like TR90 - they bend without snapping and stay light on a small nose.
• DO get the right size: eyes in the centre of the lenses, frame no wider than the face.
• DON'T buy big to grow into - loose frames slide down and kids peek over the top.
• Studies show more outdoor play is linked to less short-sightedness in children.
• FOE Kids polarised sunglasses (TR90, ages 4-10) are Buy 1 Get 1 FREE.
